The complete issue body, empty discussion and label-only timeline were read. No attachment ZIP, assignee, linked implementation or posted maintainer evidence request is present. The pasted stack is usable evidence; the local log filename is not a downloadable attachment.

comment.body: Thanks for including the exception stack. It identifies PowerToys Run 0.82.0 and the known desktop-composition error 0x80263001 tracked in #31226. That issue recommends PowerToys 0.96 or newer; newer versions handle recognized composition exceptions without opening this problem-report dialog. Please update to the latest stable PowerToys release and confirm the installed version in Settings > About. This improves recovery/reporting; it does not establish why desktop composition failed, and the fact that Netflix was open does not prove it caused the failure. If the same notice still appears after updating, include the new About version and comment `/bugreport` immediately after it recurs to collect fresh diagnostics. If Settings or the tray cannot open, run `BugReportTool.exe` from the PowerToys installation directory. There is no need to repost the old stack or your personal log path.
